svg.title: Subagents: hand a task to another agent run
svg.desc: The parent model calls delegate_task. SubAgents checks the agent name, its max_calls budget and max_depth, then runs the delegate in a new run with the parent's deps, usage and workspace, but not its conversation. The output, a steering message, or a retry comes back.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
